structured_output.what_is_happening: "d/acc" is a pump.fun coin launched about 15 minutes before detection. Its description says "Fees to @VitalikButerin via UsePaid", a service that routes pump.fun creator fees to an X handle (https://usepaid.app/explore, https://x.com/UsePaid). The coin graduated to PumpSwap quickly and pushed to an all-time high of about $710k market cap. In the 5 minutes before detection it fell 80-82%, to about $125-133k. GeckoTerminal shows the move happened in a single 15-minute burst: about $146k of volume and about 2,280 unique buyers in m15, against only about $6.9k of volume in the latest 5 minutes. I found no new Vitalik d/acc post or news event today. The d/acc idea is years old (https://cryptorank.io/news/feed/e9945-vitalik-retrospective-on-d-acc-manifesto), and earlier D/ACC memecoins already pumped and then collapsed (https://www.aicoin.com/en/article/414110).

narrative.description: A Vitalik d/acc tribute coin with creator fees routed to Vitalik's X account through UsePaid. This is a recurring pattern of 'fees to celebrity' coins.
narrative.why_spreading: The initial spike most likely came from the Vitalik name plus the UsePaid fee-sharing gimmick drawing pump.fun degens and bots. I found no fresh Vitalik post or news to keep it going, and the volume has already collapsed.

token_connection.why_this_token: It links to Vitalik's handle through UsePaid, but many tokens do this. GMGN counts 1,178 tokens launched under the linked X account, which means Vitalik's handle is attached to hundreds of pump.fun coins. Vitalik has not endorsed this coin.
token_connection.competing_tokens: There are older D/ACC and DACC coins from 2023-2024 and probably many other Vitalik-fee coins. The packet lists no same-ticker coins at the moment.

authenticity.evidence: About 2,400 unique buyers and 2,340 unique sellers in 15 minutes, with buyer and seller counts nearly equal, looks like bot and degen churn. GMGN flags 6 bundlers, 3 snipers and 31 fresh wallets, and RugCheck flags high holder correlation. There are no paid boosts and no KOL or smart-money wallets.
authenticity.uncertainty: I could see no X data, so I can't tell whether a real KOL or Vitalik-related post sparked the move.

structural_risks: Price already fell 82% from the ~$710k ATH, leaving a large supply of trapped buyers who will sell into any bounce
Volume collapsed from about $146k in 15 minutes to about $7k in the last 5 minutes
Bundlers and fresh wallets are present
A 2x from ~$130k would need about $260k, which is only a partial retrace of the ATH but requires renewed demand

structured_output.counterargument: The Vitalik brand has real pull, and the coin has more than 3,000 holders and LP that is 100% burned. If Vitalik or a large account acknowledges the fee flow, or it becomes the canonical Vitalik UsePaid coin, a retrace toward the $710k ATH would more than double the entry price. Dead-cat bounces of +100% after an 80% crash do happen on pump.fun.
unknowns: Whether Vitalik or any KOL posted about this token
The UsePaid page contents (the fetch failed with an SSL error)
Who dumped at the top: dev, bundlers or snipers

source_coverage.notes: Searching the contract address found nothing. News only covers the old d/acc concept and earlier D/ACC coins. The UsePaid page could not be fetched (SSL error). Reddit, Telegram and Discord were not searched within the time budget.

structured_output.thesis: A pump-and-crash of a generic 'fees to Vitalik' coin with no fresh catalyst. The burst of attention is already spent: price is down 82% in 5 minutes and volume has collapsed. The chance of another 2x within 6 hours is low. A classic rug is unlikely because the LP is burned, but the coin will probably bleed to near-dead.
